findings.defect: The Korean fragment completes 데려와, an order to bring Taishan here. “Go get them” changes the object to plural and omits the return destination.
findings.rationale: The preceding exchange is about whether Hyuk Mujin can bring Taishan back; the next order then expands the request to everyone. The fragment’s singular referent and bring-here direction are supported by that context.

summary: The chapter is broadly faithful, with one small dialogue-fragment mismatch in the interrupted order to bring Taishan back.
